title: Color Correction, Tonal Control & Cinematic Grading
tagline: Master scientific exposure calibration, Curves/Levels manipulation, and cinematic color palettes.
description: Understand technical color correction versus creative color grading in Affinity Photo 3.0: Histogram dynamic range analysis, clipping warnings, 18% gray White Balance calibration, per-channel RGB Curves S-curves, HSL selective color wheel shifts, Gradient Maps, and importing 3D LUT (.cube) profiles.

starterAsset.statusNote: Technical practice guide for color correction, histogram reading and color grading in Affinity Photo.
